say:1:1530114001:0.text: No, Viridian Vale has no shortage of beasts. There's always something to hunt.
say:1:1530114001:0.source_cn: 不，森瀑绿谷最不缺野兽。它们都可以成为猎物！
say:1:1530114001:0.male: No, Viridian Vale has no shortage of beasts. There's always something to hunt.
say:1:1530114001:0.female: No, Viridian Vale has no shortage of beasts. There's always something to hunt.

say:2:1530114002:0.text: But they're fierce, and only divine blessings can keep me safe from them!
say:2:1530114002:0.source_cn: 但这些野兽很凶悍。只有神的庇佑能保护我！
say:2:1530114002:0.male: But they're fierce, and only divine blessings can keep me safe from them!
say:2:1530114002:0.female: But they're fierce, and only divine blessings can keep me safe from them!
